podcast.body: The album cover for "In Through the Out Door" was designed by Storm Thorgerson, a highly acclaimed album art creator. This work is part of his extensive portfolio that defined the visual identities of numerous legendary bands. "The Led Zeppelin logo, along with the album's presence and in through the outdoor, came from Thorgerson."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Stories Behind Iconic Album Covers Part 2

podcast.body: This album was recorded at Polar Studios in Stockholm, a facility owned by ABBA. This studio later served as a functional and architectural template for Dave Grohl's 606 Studios. "That's where Led Zeppelin went to record their in-through-the-out door album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
